barNotice.lead: * Florida Bar witness-notice exception (Handbook on Lawyer Advertising and Solicitation, “Witnesses” / Standing Committee on Advertising — Solicitation of Witnesses):
barNotice.body: Florida’s lawyer advertising rules do not apply to notices to find witnesses if the lawyer has an existing client and the lawyer does not accept prospective clients as a result of placing the notice seeking witnesses.
barNotice.footnote: NOTE: Although the lawyer advertising rules do not apply to some communications, the rule prohibiting conduct involving dishonesty, fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation applies to all communications of a lawyer. Rule 4-8.4(c). This site publishes public-court and public-health information only; it is not a law firm and does not offer legal advice or client intake.

miamiWatch.title: Miami BBL Injury Case Watch:
miamiWatch.subtitle: BBL · liposuction · medspa · cosmetic surgery (public filings only)

cases.title: Erica Russell wrongful-death BBL — Seduction Cosmetic Center
cases.court: Miami-Dade County Circuit Court (Florida state court)
cases.procedure: Brazilian butt lift (BBL) / gluteal fat grafting
cases.location: Seduction Cosmetic Center, Coral Gables, FL
cases.plaintiffs: Estate of Erica Russell; children (via representatives)
cases.counselPlaintiff: Stewart Tilghman Fox Bianchi & Cain (Michael Levine, Stephen Cain)
cases.counselDefendant: Not listed in public news summaries
cases.summary: A Tennessee mother of five traveled to Miami for a BBL. The civil complaint alleges Dr. Sampson was patient No. 7 that day after a 14+ hour stretch, was not authorized to perform surgery at the center despite paperwork shown to the patient, punctured multiple organs with a cannula, injected fat into deep gluteal planes, and that Russell died of pulmonary fat emboli.

cases.title: Tracy Carpenter — infection after BBL at Spectrum Aesthetics
defendants: Spectrum Image, Inc. d/b/a Spectrum Aesthetics
cases.counselPlaintiff: Not indexed in public aggregator snippet
cases.summary: Medical-malpractice complaint alleges improper sterilization and non-sterile technique during a Miami BBL caused a severe mycobacterial infection.

cases.title: Mariella Blancas — malpractice at New Life Plastic Surgery
cases.location: New Life Plastic Surgery, Miami-Dade, FL
cases.summary: Filed under Florida’s Medical Malpractice Act (Chapter 766). Public index lists presuit compliance and venue in Miami-Dade.

cases.title: Melecia Green — death after tummy tuck & liposuction (New Life)
cases.procedure: Abdominoplasty and liposuction (not BBL; same clinic ecosystem)
cases.location: New Life Plastic Surgery, West Miami-Dade, FL
cases.plaintiffs: Andrew Green (surviving spouse) on behalf of estate and minor child
cases.summary: Patient collapsed from pulmonary embolism less than 40 hours after surgery. Herald reported a structured settlement after wrongful-death litigation tied to high-volume Miami cosmetic centers.

sourcing: Florida state trial courts publish filings through county clerks (Miami-Dade OCS, Orange County, etc.).
Federal courts: PACER / CourtListener RECAP for U.S. District and Bankruptcy filings.
Florida Board of Medicine emergency orders and Florida Administrative Code 64B8-9.009 (gluteal fat grafting standards).
News articles link to primary reporting; they are not substitutes for reading the complaint.
Third-party docket aggregators (UniCourt, PacerMonitor) summarize public indices; verify case numbers with the official clerk before citing in court.
